$comment: Optimus metrics the estate can measure itself (founder 2026-11-20: nothing ships without its Optimus metrics). A SHIP-CONTRACT may only name a metric registered here; Greenlane reads it by running `measure` from main, never from what an author says. A measure prints exactly `optimus.<name>=<number>` and needs no cluster or secret.

metrics.name: estate.platform_dirs_never_applied
metrics.description: platform/ kustomize directories that no Flux Kustomization applies (idp#8328)

metrics.name: claims.ship_contract_enforced
metrics.description: 1 when bin/claim-gate refuses a claim with no SHIP-CONTRACT and admits it with one (idp#8350)

metrics.name: estate.zone_a_graph_drain_files
metrics.description: Zone A Mac graph-drain artifacts on main (source + launchd template); decommissioned 2026-11-22, ingestion is Zone B cloud-only (idp#8412)

metrics.name: legion.missions_landed
metrics.description: Conservative count of reachable main agent-sandbox (auto) landings joined by Greenlane-Head to a genuine Run receipt in the exact source commit (Git object or authenticated GitHub API); never a live inference or external effect claim (idp#8283/#8405)

metrics.name: greenlane.cross_main_failure_cap
metrics.description: Independent trusted-main execution of the actual Engine two-main unchanged-head identical-cause suppression, durable restart, changed-head re-admission, and UNKNOWN refusal (#8289); not a claim of external service availability

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_failures
metrics.description: Fatal R2 failure points in bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare's DNS/Workers critical path (I-8455 Stage 1: R2 gates only R2), counted as sites: the R2 mint path (fail mint "R2 token not created") plus every fatal 'fail r2' in the R2 bucket-proof path. Measured on main 2026-11-26 (dd4c1e8be): baseline 5 (1 mint + 4 bucket-proof), target 0 -- it reads 0 when I-8455 Stage 1 lands. The measure prints nothing and exits non-zero when it cannot judge the script, so the readback is UNKNOWN rather than a false 0 (idp#8575)

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_measure_reads
measure: import pathlib,re,subprocess; p=pathlib.Path('bin/optimus-r2-scoped-failures'); r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True); ok=bool(re.search(r'(?m)^optimus\.bootstrap\.r2_scoped_failures=-?\d+$',r.stdout or '')); print('optimus.bootstrap.r2_scoped_measure_reads=%d' % (1 if ok else 0))
metrics.description: 1 when the registered measure for bootstrap.r2_scoped_failures runs on main and prints a well-formed optimus.<name>=<number> line -- the readback is the deliverable, and a measure that cannot read is a metric that cannot fail (idp#8575); baseline 0, target 1

metrics.name: pr_age.red_runs_baseline_break
metrics.description: scheduled pr-age sweeps that exit BLIND/2 on a dead repo in the default --repos list (run 45595449643, idp#8537)

metrics.name: plan_lock.live_plan_refusals
measure:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "platform/estate/memory")
import plan as P

r = P.apply(None, "declare_plan", {"goal": "ship the feature", "subgoals": [{"id": "g1", "text": "first step"}]})
ok = bool(P.authorize("Edit", r.get("plan")).get("ok"))
print("optimus.plan_lock.live_plan_refusals=%d" % (0 if ok else 1))
metrics.description: ordinary tool calls the plan gate refuses after a plan is declared: 1 before idp#8558, 0 after (a declared plan is LIVE; the scenario is required before the goal is claimed done)

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_gate
measure: import pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare').read_text() if pathlib.Path('bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare').exists() else ''; print('optimus.bootstrap.r2_scoped_gate=%d' % (1 if ('R2 gates only R2' in s and 'R2_SCOPE_FAILED' in s) else 0))
metrics.description: 1 when an R2 mint failure gates only R2: DNS and Workers always mint, verify and vault (I-8455 Stage 1, idp#8519); baseline 0, target 1

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_warn_markers
measure: f=bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -c 'R2 gates only R2' "$f" || echo 0
metrics.description: Scoped R2 WARN markers in bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare (I-8455 Stage 1, idp#8519); baseline 0, target >=4

metrics.name: context.committed_claimless_read
metrics.description: Actual broker policy invocation with deterministic engine fixture; read committed index without GitHub claim lookup, reject traversal and unclaimed working-copy. Source-policy proof only, not a deployed endpoint measurement.

metrics.name: ci.facts_rung_time_reds
metrics.description: 1 when bin/idp-ci rung 1e reds a lane on a STALE-only facts store -- the passage of time, not the lane (idp#8602)

metrics.name: guard.self_kill_cases_failing
metrics.description: falsifier cases the api-port-guard fails: an agent signalling its own model/UI path or another harness, or a read refused for mentioning a service (idp#8598)

metrics.name: claims.holder_lapse_refusals
metrics.description: 1 when claim-gate on a laptop refuses a push whose only fault is the pusher's own lapsed heartbeat, 0 when the push renews it (idp#8609)

metrics.name: enforce.shared_name_holder_refusals
metrics.description: shared ESTATE_AGENT spellings (claim-open's SHARED_AGENT_NAMES plus case/space variants) under which the write gate refuses a holder its own live claim (idp#8606)

metrics.name: catalog.disjoint_registration_conflicts
metrics.description: catalog files claim-gate's merge-check calls conflicting when two lanes register DIFFERENT keys in the real catalogs (main before idp#8615: 2, fix: 0)

metrics.name: dispatch.headless_plan_denials
metrics.description: of the two denials measured on 2026-11-27 (the plan tools, and a permission mode that needs an approver), how many the headless launcher's claude argv still reproduces (idp#8611)

metrics.name: claims.queue_lapse_refusals
metrics.description: 1 when claim-gate in CI refuses a head authored one minute after its holder's claim, judged 24 minutes later (the measured 2026-11-27 queue wait); 0 when the wait no longer lapses it (idp#8629)

metrics.name: handback.state_reports_refused
metrics.description: of four state reports on a tracked object (PR #N still open, a status-table row, a pull URL, a lane branch), how many the Stop hook's hand-back judge refuses (idp#8622)

metrics.name: brief.unclean_endings_unreported
metrics.description: of three sessions that did not end cleanly (Claude Code API error x3, Claude Code killed mid-tool, pi lane error), how many the session-start brief fails to name (idp#8624)

metrics.name: context.turn1_rule_tokens
metrics.description: Estimated tokens (bytes/4 x 1.15, errs high against cl100k_base) of the rule files every agent auto-loads in this repository before its first tool call: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and their peers. The cap is 1500 (policy/context-policy.v1.json); 17353 on main 8b1af4a60 (idp#8492).

metrics.name: estate_mcp.build_checks_failing
metrics.description: Cases where estate-mcp.Dockerfile's python -c build checks fail against the files the image copies, measured before merge. 1 against main c8dc5b538 (the stale _invoke_remote check that turned build-multiarch red); 0 with idp#8650.

metrics.name: rust.image_lock_floor_violations
metrics.description: Rule violations across the Rust images bin/dockerfiles lists: no committed or copied Cargo.lock, cargo build without --locked, no rust-version, or a rust:<x.y> builder below it. 11 on main 618156854 (genesis-v1, edge-runtime, ground-truth, pennyd); 0 with idp#8652.

metrics.name: lane_where.false_gone_cases
metrics.description: Pinned shapes where bin/lane-where answers GONE for a lane whose content is in main. 1 on main 618156854 (a lane landed after the clone's last fetch); 0 with idp#8653.

metrics.name: images.os_upgrade_layer_not_refreshable
metrics.description: Images bin/dockerfiles lists whose OS-upgrade layer has no ARG OS_PACKAGES_AS_OF before it, so the GHCR layer cache replays it and published OS fixes never arrive. 15 on main 618156854; 0 with idp#8655.

metrics.name: portal.install_time_downloads_enabled
metrics.description: Declared install-time downloads the portal never uses that are still enabled in backstage/package.json, plus a yarn.lock root that does not mirror its dependenciesMeta. 1 on main c82f68ea8; 0 with idp#8655.

metrics.name: legion.fitness_gate_enforced
metrics.description: 1 when bin/legion-admit --harness auto, run end to end with a dummy key and every HTTPS connection trapped locally, refuses an auto route with no FIT record and one with an UNFIT record with zero provider connections, and admits a fresh FIT record at launch settings to the probe. 0 on main c82f68e; 1 with idp#3525.

metrics.name: images.lago_api_critical_gems_unpatched
metrics.description: CRITICAL gem advisories in the lago-api base image's lock (ADVISORIES in the test) that lago-api.Dockerfile does not patch to the fixed version. 1 on main 186bc1952; 0 with idp#8658.

metrics.name: images.hindsight_api_critical_pkgs_unfloored
metrics.description: CRITICAL advisories in the hindsight-api vendor venv (ADVISORIES in the test) that hindsight-api.Dockerfile does not floor at the fixed version. 4 on main 43af9f558; 0 with idp#6113.

metrics.name: hooks.enforce_shared_name_unresolved_when_relocated
metrics.description: 1 when estate-memory-enforce, copied alone into a bin/ without claim-open (the deployed layout), refuses a live claim's holder under ESTATE_AGENT=estate-agent. 1 on main 43af9f558; 0 with idp#8660.

metrics.name: hooks.enforce_rules_lost_when_relocated
metrics.description: Of the DoF repair lock, the founder's governance and the pin, how many a copy of bin/estate-memory-enforce deployed alone (as bin/estate-memory-install deploys it) cannot read when it judges a path in an idp checkout. 3 on main 0f9d86375, 0 with idp#8660's sweep.

metrics.name: images.hindsight_api_floor_sites_unchecked
metrics.description: 1 when hindsight-api.Dockerfile's build-time floor check, run against a fake image tree, passes uv 0.12.5 in the system interpreter (usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages), which Trivy fails. 1 on main 86a662e3c (main run 46049122666); 0 with idp#8667.

metrics.name: hooks.enforce_refuses_on_unreadable_incidents
metrics.description: 1 when estate-memory-enforce's dof_verdict refuses a write because dof-gate could not read the incident list (the dof-probe sentinel). 1 on main b04af78dc (refused every idp write fleet-wide on 2026-11-27 when the anonymous GitHub budget ran out); 0 with idp#8669.

metrics.name: memory.door_imports_crash_on_exit
metrics.description: Guarded `import door`/`import local_store` sites in bin, platform, greenlane and mcp whose handlers let SystemExit escape (local_store exits on a missing dependency), so the caller crashes instead of returning its verdict. 4 on main 6b7932fd3; 0 with idp#8672.

metrics.name: hooks.enforce_dies_when_door_exits
metrics.description: 1 when bin/estate-memory-enforce dies on import because `import door` raised SystemExit (local_store without pydantic), which made every measure loading the hook UNKNOWN to Greenlane (idp#8660 judged NOT OPERATIONAL 2026-11-27T19:10:55Z). 1 on main 6b7932fd3; 0 with idp#8672.

metrics.name: recovery.idle_queue_judged_blind
metrics.description: 1 when require_idle_command_queue calls the OCI CLI's empty stdout (an idle queue) BLIND, refusing every recovery run (idp#7387); 0 when an idle queue is idle.
